items.text: Today's update focuses on addressing the most commonly reported findings and improving the overall gameplay experience:
Optimized the sound mixing of character voices across the board. While Alfred may not be the youngest anymore, he should still be able to understand the people around him.

Actions relevant to achievements are now correctly counted in Chapter Select as well. This is especially useful if you want to revisit chapters to collect any missing vignettes or resting opportunities.
Fixed an issue where photos taken during gameplay would sometimes be missing from the Journal Photo Selection sequence.
Fixed a rare issue where taking a photo within a vignette would prevent the sequence from progressing.
Fixed various text rendering issues with Asian languages.
Fixed an issue where Alfred's arms would sometimes disappear when opening the Journal, making it look like he had mastered the art of telekinesis.
Fixed an issue where look sensitivity settings were not correctly applied to the in-camera controls.
Fixed a rare issue where a cutscene might not trigger if Alfred tightened the bolts too quickly in the Sam's Detour chapter.
Fixed an issue where the cutscene in Sam's chapter would sometimes fail to continue if a selfie was taken too quickly.

Fixed an issue where it was possible to interact with the resort's entrance turnstile again after reloading a checkpoint, essentially trapping Alfred in an endless loop of never escaping Marley's resort.
Fixed an issue where the interaction marker at the resort's boat shed was harder to trigger than intended.
Fixed an issue where the Guardian Lord music from the arcade could continue playing indefinitely during normal gameplay (it was fun while it lasted...).
Fixed a very unfortunate and rare issue where the music in the Mountain chapter would briefly pause during a Trauma sequence.
\[STEAM DECK] Added a Quit button to the main menu and included the previously missing left-hand layout option.
Find the full list of fixes for all platforms here: https://forever-ago.com/patch-notes/
